audience.text: Developers building .NET applications who need to create, read, edit, and convert Word documents programmatically without licensing costs, especially those targeting .NET Framework 4.6.2+, .NET 6/8/10, Windows, Linux, or macOS.

capabilities.text: Create documents from scratch using Document or DocumentBuilder, add text, formatting, tables, lists, sections, headers, footers, bookmarks, and comments.
capabilities.title: Create and edit documents

capabilities.text: Apply paragraph and character formatting, manage styles, control page layout with PageSetup, and adjust borders, shading, and text orientation.
capabilities.title: Format and style content

capabilities.text: Convert between DOCX, Markdown, and plain text formats using Save with SaveFormat values and Load with LoadFormat options.
capabilities.title: Convert document formats

capabilities.text: Inspect, accept, or reject tracked changes and revisions using Revision, RevisionCollection, and Document methods.
capabilities.title: Process tracked changes

capabilities.text: Append, clone, and import content between documents using AppendDocument and ImportNode with ImportFormatMode options.
capabilities.title: Merge and combine documents

capabilities.text: Access embedded Chart objects through Shape nodes, read and modify series values, axes, legend, and data labels without rendering to images.
capabilities.title: Inspect and modify charts

capabilities.text: Check whether a DOCX file is digitally signed and untampered, inspect certificate details, or remove signatures using DigitalSignature APIs.
capabilities.title: Verify digital signatures

capabilities.text: Protect documents with passwords using ProtectionType and Unprotect methods, and round-trip macro-enabled files (DOCM/DOTM) with VBA projects intact.
capabilities.title: Protect documents

limitations.text: No page layout or rendering capabilities; cannot save to PDF, XPS, or image formats, and layout-dependent field values evaluate to placeholders.
Limited format support; only DOCX, Markdown, and plain text are read and written, excluding DOC, RTF, ODT, HTML, and EPUB.
No mail merge, LINQ Reporting, document comparison, document signing, or embedded-font subsetting functionality.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Word document processing in .NET without Microsoft Office automation, supporting cross-platform deployment on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Provides a free, open-source alternative to commercial document processing libraries with a compatible API, allowing migration from other solutions or avoiding licensing fees.
Supports document conversion between DOCX, Markdown, and plain text formats, facilitating interoperability with other systems and documentation workflows.
Enables inspection and modification of tracked changes, comments, bookmarks, tables, and other document elements through a comprehensive object model.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Words FOSS for .NET is an open-source .NET library derived from the genuine Aspose.Words commercial codebase, providing document processing capabilities for DOCX, Markdown, and plain text without requiring Microsoft Word.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond DOCX, Markdown, and plain text is not fully specified in the fact dossier.
Whether the library supports reading or writing RTF, ODT, or HTML is not confirmed by the fact dossier despite the README mentioning them as unsupported.
The specific behavior of layout-dependent fields like page numbers in TOC is described in the README but not directly verified by fact IDs.
The exact mechanism and limitations of VBA macro round-tripping are not detailed in the fact dossier.
Whether chart rendering to images is supported is not confirmed by the fact dossier despite the README stating it is not included.
The scope of SkiaSharp usage on Linux and dependency requirements beyond the README are not fully detailed in the fact dossier.
The exact test coverage and gold file comparison mechanism is described in the README but not directly verified by fact IDs.

workflows.name: Create and edit documents
workflows.text: Developers create new documents using Document or DocumentBuilder, add content like paragraphs, tables, and bookmarks, and save in supported formats.

workflows.name: Convert document formats
workflows.text: Load a DOCX file and save it as Markdown or plain text, or vice versa, using the Save method with appropriate SaveFormat values.

workflows.name: Process tracked changes
workflows.text: Load a document with tracked changes, inspect revisions, and accept or reject them programmatically using Revision and RevisionCollection APIs.

workflows.name: Merge documents
workflows.text: Append content from one document to another using AppendDocument with ImportFormatMode to combine documents while preserving formatting.

workflows.name: Inspect embedded charts
workflows.text: Access Chart objects through Shape nodes, read and modify series data, axes, and data labels without rendering the chart to an image.

workflows.name: Build and test from source
workflows.text: Clone the repository, run dotnet build Aspose.Words.sln to compile, and dotnet test Aspose.Words.sln to execute tests in Aspose.Words.Tests/.
